purpose: Bridge the five-year agency orchestration, source provenance, MCP risk, and Stitch UX catalogs into the existing Apple-first Swift package without touching Swift source in this slice.
bridgePrinciples: Swift is used for real architectural value, not language statistics.
Swift models should mirror stable public-safe contracts before SwiftUI shell work expands.
SwiftUI shell work must preserve accessible labels, reduced-motion expectations, and no-key demo boundaries.
Stitch screens inform module vocabulary and shell layout only after review.
AI Core surfaces must keep demo/live boundaries explicit across demo, local-ready, cloud-ready, blocked, and failed states.
MCP and provider surfaces must never expose credentials in public repo files.
The web demo remains the public showcase while Swift becomes the long-term Apple-first backbone.

qualityGates: No Swift source is touched in this manifest-only slice.
No symbolic Swift files are allowed.
Swift models must load public-safe JSON fixtures before SwiftUI surfaces expand.
SwiftUI panels must preserve accessible names and visible state labels.
AI Core UI must not claim live provider calls.
MCP UI must not activate servers without approval.
Stitch assets must not be copied before license, size, and public-safe review.
The web demo remains no-key and preserved.
